name: gizza-ai/iam-policy-linter
summary: Lint AWS IAM policy JSON for risky wildcards and policy syntax issues

tool.description: Validate an AWS IAM policy JSON document locally and flag grammar errors plus risky permissions such as Action/Resource wildcards, Allow + NotAction/NotResource/NotPrincipal, public principals, iam:PassRole on Resource *, and sensitive action families on unconstrained resources. Choose identity, resource, trust or SCP policy semantics; render text, JSON or CSV; filter display by severity; and suppress reviewed rule codes explicitly.

format.description: Output format: text for a readable verdict and findings, json for CI or automation, or csv for spreadsheet/ticket exports. Default text.

ignore.description: Comma-separated rule codes to suppress from the report and verdict after review, e.g. MISSING-VERSION,RESOURCE-STAR. Unknown codes are errors so typos cannot silently hide nothing.

min_severity.description: Display threshold for findings. The verdict still counts all non-ignored findings; this only hides lower-severity rows from the rendered output. Default low.

policy.description: AWS IAM policy JSON to lint. Paste one identity policy, resource policy, trust policy, or service control policy document. JSON only; maximum 200000 characters.

policy_type.description: How AWS will attach this document: identity (user/group/role permissions, no Principal), resource (bucket/key/queue-style policy, Principal required), trust (role AssumeRolePolicyDocument, Principal required and Resource forbidden), or scp (Organizations service control policy rules). Default identity.
